subject: music

moments.title: Prelude a l'apres-midi d'un faune
moments.body: Pierre Boulez later called this 10-minute work the moment modern music begins.
moments.takeaway: Modernist music had a soft, fluid beginning.

moments.title: La Mer
moments.body: Debussy's three symphonic sketches of the sea, with their Hokusai-derived cover, draw on non-Western influences.
moments.takeaway: Modernism absorbed visual and global culture.

moments.title: Debussy dies
moments.body: Debussy dies during World War I. His tonal experiments shape 20th-century jazz harmony.
moments.takeaway: Impressionism in music influenced popular as much as classical idioms.

now.title: French modernism now
now.body: Boulez and Pierre-Laurent Aimard have championed French modernist recordings. Debussy's harmony now underpins much film scoring.
now.open_questions: How much do current 'pretty' harmonies owe to Debussy?

reflection: Music could move without obvious cadences. Debussy proved it.
